versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the open-stackoverflow skill.
- Opens Stack Overflow in the user's Brave browser.
- Reuses an existing Stack Overflow tab/session when possible.
- Focuses Brave if running; waits for page to load and verifies the correct site.
- Respects user authentication session; prompts for sign-in if authentication is required.
- Only opens and verifies the website—does not modify content.
